_comment: Sarthi wordfinder keywords. Copy this file to keywords.json (same folder) and edit it — or run 'python -m brain.wordfinder add <keyword>'. Each keyword ends an 'open ...' target: the interpreter stops the target at the first known keyword instead of swallowing the whole sentence, so 'open chatgpt and get prompt ...' opens 'chatgpt'. Multi-word keywords work ('chat gpt'). Add the apps and sites you ask about often.
